newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania police arrest Hoxha relative in swoop.
newsitem.headline: Albania police arrest Hoxha relative in swoop.

text.p: Albanian police have arrested the son-in-law of late communist dictator Enver Hoxha in an operation the interior minister said on Wednesday busted a guerrilla organisation of former secret police members.
Interior Minister Halit Shamata told a news conference that Klement Kolaneci was detained after money believed to have been stolen by the group was found at his home.

"We have discovered a terrorist organisation of a political character," he said. "It aimed to destabilise the public order by destroying...state objects and big private companies, killing persons with senior official posts, killing police and judicial staff, robbing banks and savings deposits."

The police action against officials of the former communist regime comes days before nationwide local elections in which the ruling Democratic Party is pitted against the main opposition Socialist Party, the former communist party.

The crackdown followed news on Tuesday that police had arrested the suspected killers of director-general of prisons Bujar Kaloshi, who was shot dead last July. The same group is believed to be responsible for a car bomb attack in Tirana, which killed four and wounded 27.
Shamata said the group had stolen about $1 million from different banks and companies. Police also found an arsenal of arms belonging to the organisation.
Two sons of Hajredin Shyti, the ex-communist deputy interior minister, were among the ringleaders, he noted.
Shyti is currently serving a 17-year jail sentence imposed in December 1992 for responsibility in the police killing of four Albanians in riots following 1991 general elections.
